name: [BUG-OT-006] TC-OT-014 — DELETE /api/v1/token: Must return 405 Method Not Allowed (returns 500)
description:
**[KNOWN BUG — BUG-OT-006]**

**What this test does:**
Sends a DELETE request to /api/v1/token (a GET-only endpoint — the DELETE endpoint is /api/v1/token/cache) and verifies the server returns 405 Method Not Allowed.

**Expected:** HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed
**Actual:** HTTP 500 Internal Server Error

**Root Cause:** Same as BUG-OT-005 — unsupported methods trigger an unhandled exception in the service instead of a standard 405 response.

**Additional Risk:** A client who mistypes the path and sends DELETE /api/v1/token instead of DELETE /api/v1/token/cache will receive a confusing 500 instead of a helpful 405 that would guide them to the correct endpoint.
